assumptions.algorithm: Connection Scan Algorithm (multi-pass, with walking transfers)

_meta.null_meaning: minutes = null means no journey of 110 minutes or less was found, or the address could not be geocoded. It never means zero.
_meta.what_this_is: A modelled door-to-door journey time for every hotel x destination pair, computed by this script from the official MTA static GTFS timetable.
what_this_is_not: not a 2027 trip plan — the static feed carries the current timetable and omits most temporary service changes
not a live disruption, elevator or weather check
